Chapter 1287: 35: Suspicion And Astonishment

Chapter 1287: Chapter 35: Suspicion and Astonishment

According to reason, the imminent arrival of the Eternal Envoy is a top secret of the Qingyun Saint Sect.

After all, it involves the power of the Eternal Sect at the center of the world.

In the rampant situation of the ‘demonic threat’, the fewer people know, the better.

But the Sect Master of the Holy Sect is very aware that the safety of the entire Qingyun Saint Sect now hinges on Lin Yuan.

Eternal Envoy?

Compared to Lin Yuan’s protection of the Qingyun Saint Sect, what does the Eternal Envoy count for?

The collective help of past Eternal Envoys does not surpass Lin Yuan’s sweeping away all the ‘demons’ near the Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

Therefore, between the Eternal Envoy and Lin Yuan.

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect chose the latter without hesitation.

He informed Lin Yuan of the imminent arrival of the Eternal Envoy without omission.

Lin Yuan fell into brief contemplation.

Actually, he did not have much aversion to the power of the Eternal Sect at the center of the world.

His goals even coincide with those of the various Eternal Lords.

The various Eternal Lords do not wish for this source world to be destroyed under the ‘demonic threat’.

Lin Yuan also does not wish for that.

All the heavens and myriad realms, Endless Dimensional Planes.

There are very few dimensional spaces that can reach the level of this source world.

Such a world can completely become one of Lin Yuan’s bases, to counter unknown risks.

The barriers between different dimensional planes are enough to isolate the attack perceptions of Thirteenth-level time beings.

Even strong figures like the Time Lord find it difficult to cross.

“What matters will the Eternal Envoy bring over?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Sect Master of the Holy Sect and asked.

“Based on previous experiences with the arrival of Eternal Envoys, they generally investigate nearby ‘demonic’ intelligence and share some rune secret skills to combat the ‘demons’.”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect truthfully replied.

“Moreover, the envoys will enlist some sect experts, especially the talented disciples, to take back to the Eternal Sect at the center of the world for training.”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect continued.

The Qingyun Saint Sect feels both anticipation and distress regarding the arrival of the Eternal Envoy.

The rune secret skills shared by the Eternal Envoy are indeed very useful to the Holy Sect.

However, taking away sect experts and talented disciples? It might cause the Qingyun Saint Sect to face a gap risk.

The life disciples originally nurtured within the small world inside the Qingyun Sacred Mountain have talents not equal to those outside.

Are further extracted by the Eternal Sect?

In the short term, it might not matter, but over time, the impact becomes extremely vile.

Currently there are only three or four experts at the Peak of Longevity Sixth Realm in the Qingyun Saint Sect, far below the number before the great change of the world.

The main reason is due to the rampant ‘demonic threat’, but the repeated enlistment by the Eternal Envoy also holds a significant impact.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan lightly nodded.

There was nothing surprising.

For Holy Sect forces like the Qingyun Saint Sect, their utility to the Eternal Sect at the center of the world is just twofold.

One is to distract more attention from the ‘demons’.

The other is to serve as a reserve site for disciples.

This is also the reason why the Eternal Sect sends envoys to support all the great Holy Sects.

Without sufficient benefits, the forces of the Eternal Sect, under the threat of multiple source demons, are already self-absorbed, how could they be this charitable?

“Give me the rune used for contacting the forces of the Eternal Sect.”

Lin Yuan thought for a while and spoke.

The ‘demonic threat’ descends, and many means of contact will be suppressed.

Lin Yuan is rather curious about the method the Eternal Envoy uses for directly connecting with all the great Holy Sects and locking down their specific positions.

It is worth noting, over the long years, to evade stronger ‘demons’, the Qingyun Sacred Mountain has relocated seven or eight times.

“Yes.”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect immediately took out a cyan rune and respectfully handed it to Lin Yuan.

“This rune?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed.

From the surface, this cyan rune is a conventional rune.

But within Lin Yuan’s field of vision, this cyan rune is composed of billions of smaller runes.

Each small rune is continuously rotating.

Interwoven and colliding with others of similar small runes.

Forming a subtle balance.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan assessed.

The inheritance left by the Lord of Heaven Light, Lin Yuan has already started cultivating the fourth level.

Everything perceived and known became runes, all could be utilized by him.

At present, this cyan rune is exceedingly difficult and obscure, besides the corresponding experts of the Eternal Sect and the Sect Master of the Qingyun Saint Sect.

Outsiders simply cannot use it.

Even the Sect Master of the Qingyun Saint Sect can only use it roughly, to receive occasional messages transmitted by the envoys of the Eternal Sect.

As for more?

There is none.

But in Lin Yuan’s eyes, he was starting to swiftly take control of each small rune.

Rustling.

The next moment.

The complete cyan rune suddenly disintegrated, forming billions of small runes, floating before Lin Yuan.

Within a short time.

The billions of small runes reunited, reforming that same cyan rune.

Only now this cyan rune had been entirely mastered by Lin Yuan.

“This?”

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect watched the entire process, his heart filled with immense shock.

Even though he did not know why the cyan rune dispersed, he could discern that the reformed cyan rune already differed from the previous one.

If the initial cyan rune fundamentally belonged to the Eternal Sect, with at most slight usage rights for the Sect Master of the Holy Sect.

Then the current cyan rune has shifted from belonging to the Eternal Sect to belonging to Lin Yuan.

But how is this possible?

The cyan rune crafted by the Eternal Sect, as described by the previous Eternal Envoy, this kind of cyan rune was personally refined by the Eternal Lord, serving as the ultimate means of communication between all the great Holy Sects and the Eternal Sect.
